cond_0001.intro:
As a Fraud Operations Analyst, you will act as a fraud-fighting detective and be responsible for helping make [Company name masked] the safest and most secure payroll and benefits solution. We find patterns, recognize uncharacteristic behavior, and put our critical thinking to use constantly. Not only are we detectives but we don't stop looking to iterate and optimize the way we do things so that we can keep becoming more efficient and reducing customer pain.
The Risk Operations organization is at the core of our business and our team is a key stakeholder in company decisions and operations - The Fraud Operations team safeguards our customers, company, and platform integrity. We currently process +$50bn of payroll annually, but with your help, we will process more in a safe and sustainable way. We are a small, close, fun group that works hard and laughs a lot. No egos here — we collaborate and help each other out in a positive environment.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Hunt fraudsters. You are our internal police force - prevent the bad guys from abusing our system by reviewing, monitoring and investigating new accounts and suspicious activity.
Solve puzzles. Fraud is a complicated puzzle to solve. Come up with innovative methods to identify trends, patterns, and ultimately, catch the bad guys.
Operate cutting-edge tools. Scope and drive continual enhancements to our systems and processes to identify and eliminate fraudulent activity.
Work closely with key stakeholders. Work cross-functionally with internal teams, our customers, and external partners.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2+ Years of experience in operational work, detection and/or investigation.
An insatiable appetite for problem solving, knack for structured thinking using a data driven approach, ability to spot unusual patterns, and sharp attention to detail.
Driven by a strong moral compass, is objective yet compassionate, and does the right thing every time.
Excellent time management skills and ability to handle multiple projects/tasks simultaneously. Is extremely process and policy oriented.
Goal-oriented, positive, and proactive. Comfortable in a fast-paced, results-oriented work environment. Communicates well with others.
Preferred Requirements
Experience in the banking or payments industry.
Professional certifications (CFE).
Payroll industry experience.
Professional tech experience.
SQL knowledge.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0001.values: We value work that reflects care for people and consideration for its wider impact. We aim to make decisions in ways that are responsible, fair, and respectful.

We find patterns, recognize uncharacteristic behavior, and put our critical thinking to use constantly. Not only are we detectives but we don't stop looking to iterate and optimize the way we do things so that we can keep becoming more efficient and reducing customer pain.
The Risk Operations organization is at the core of our business and our team is a key stakeholder in company decisions and operations — the Fraud Operations team safeguards our customers, company, and platform integrity. We currently process +$50bn of payroll annually, but with your help, we will process more in a safe and sustainable way. We are a small, close, fun group that works hard and laughs a lot. No egos here — we collaborate and help each other out in a positive environment.
cond_0024.responsibilities:
Hunt fraudsters. You are our internal police force — prevent the bad guys from abusing our system by actively reviewing, monitoring, and investigating new accounts and suspicious activity, staying in regular contact with the team to flag issues early.
Solve puzzles. Fraud is a complicated puzzle to solve. Come up with innovative methods to identify trends, patterns, and ultimately catch the bad guys, and speak up when you spot something worth discussing.
Operate cutting-edge tools. Scope and drive continual enhancements to our systems and processes to identify and eliminate fraudulent activity.
Work closely with key stakeholders. Connect daily with internal teams, our customers, and external partners, walking them through findings and handling questions as they come up.
cond_0024.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2+ Years of experience in operational work, detection and/or investigation.
An insatiable appetite for problem solving, knack for structured thinking using a data driven approach, ability to spot unusual patterns, and sharp attention to detail.
Driven by a strong moral compass, is objective yet compassionate, and does the right thing every time.
Excellent time management skills and ability to handle multiple projects/tasks simultaneously. Is extremely process and policy oriented.
Goal-oriented, positive, and proactive. Comfortable in a results-oriented work environment. Communicates well with others.
Preferred Requirements
Experience in the banking or payments industry.
Payroll industry experience.
Professional certifications (CFE).
Professional tech experience.
SQL knowledge.

As a Fraud Operations Analyst, you will act as a fraud-fighting detective and be responsible for helping make [Company name masked] the safest and most secure payroll and benefits solution. We find patterns, recognize uncharacteristic behavior, and put our critical thinking to use constantly. Not only are we detectives but we don't stop looking to iterate and optimize the way we do things so that we can keep becoming more efficient and reducing customer pain.
The Risk Operations organization is at the core of our business and our team is a key stakeholder in company decisions and operations - The Fraud Operations team safeguards our customers, company, and platform integrity. We currently process +$50bn of payroll annually, but with your help, we will process more in a safe and sustainable way. We are a small, close, fun group that works hard and laughs a lot. No egos here — we collaborate and help each other out in a positive environment.
Most people become stronger in fraud detection and investigation work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0122.responsibilities: Hunt fraudsters. You are our internal police force - prevent the bad guys from abusing our system by reviewing, monitoring and investigating new accounts and suspicious activity. Solve puzzles. Fraud is a complicated puzzle to solve. Come up with innovative methods to identify trends, patterns, and ultimately, catch the bad guys. Operate cutting-edge tools. Scope and drive continual enhancements to our systems and processes to identify and eliminate fraudulent activity. Work closely with key stakeholders. Work cross-functionally with internal teams, our customers, and external partners.
cond_0122.requirements:
2+ Years of experience in operational work, detection and/or investigation. Bonus if in the banking or payments industry.
An insatiable appetite for problem solving, knack for structured thinking using a data driven approach, ability to spot unusual patterns, and sharp attention to detail.
Driven by a strong moral compass, is objective yet compassionate, and does the right thing every time.
Excellent time management skills and ability to handle multiple projects/tasks simultaneously. Is extremely process and policy oriented.
Goal-oriented, positive, and proactive. Comfortable in a fast-paced, results-oriented work environment. Communicates well with others.
Professional certifications (CFE)
Payroll industry experience
Professional Tech experience
SQL knowledge

The Risk Operations organization is at the core of our business and our team is a key stakeholder in company decisions and operations - The Fraud Operations team safeguards our customers, company, and platform integrity. We currently process +$50bn of payroll annually, but with your help, we will process more in a safe and sustainable way. We are a small, close, fun group that works hard and laughs a lot. No egos here — we collaborate and help each other out in a positive environment.
cond_0515.responsibilities: Hunt fraudsters. You are our internal police force - prevent the bad guys from abusing our system by reviewing, monitoring and investigating new accounts and suspicious activity. Solve puzzles. Fraud is a complicated puzzle to solve. Come up with innovative methods to identify trends, patterns, and ultimately, catch the bad guys. Operate cutting-edge tools. Scope and drive continual enhancements to our systems and processes to identify and eliminate fraudulent activity. Work closely with key stakeholders. Work cross-functionally with internal teams, our customers, and external partners.
cond_0515.requirements:
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise in operational work, detection and/or investigation. Significant background in the banking or payments industry strongly preferred.
Proven track record of structured, data-driven problem solving, with an advanced ability to spot unusual patterns and exceptional attention to detail.
Driven by a strong moral compass, is objective yet compassionate, and does the right thing every time.
Exceptional time management skills and demonstrated ability to handle multiple projects/tasks simultaneously. Deeply process and policy oriented.
Goal-oriented, positive, and proactive. Strong communication skills and the ability to deliver results consistently.
Professional certifications (CFE)
Substantial payroll industry experience
Extensive professional tech experience
Advanced knowledge of SQL
cond_0515.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0515.workplace_support: We are committed to creating a workplace where people can grow, connect, and build their careers with confidence. Employees have access to knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and career-development resources designed to support growth over time.
